 PL: Pierre Sage at risk, Chelsea slip again, Brighton living the dream! 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article The verdict is in from the Premier League's simultaneous kick-offs.
 Premier League matchday 10 continued this Sunday with four games kicking off at the same time.
 OneFootball Videos
 This afternoon, things took a serious turn for the worse for Pierre Sage, whose Crystal Palace side were soundly beaten by Liverpool (1-3). The Eagles fell to goals from Alexis Mac Allister, Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak. Bradley Barcola also provided the assist for the Reds' second goal.
 After 10 Premier League games, Crystal Palace sit rock bottom, and the French manager's job looks more precarious than ever!
 Crystal Palace 1 Liverpool FC 3 Today Full time Meanwhile, Chelsea suffered another setback away at Sunderland (1-0). Still without Joao Pedro, Xabi Alonso's men were tormented by an unstoppable Bryan Brobbey, who won the decisive penalty converted by Enzo Le Fée.
 Elsewhere, Bournemouth got the better of a struggling Ipswich side (1-2). Finally, Brighton continued their stunning start to the season with a deserved win over Brentford (2-0). The Bees were reduced to 10 men early on after Igor Thiago was sent off for striking Chemas Andrés in the face.
 The surprise package of the season so far, Brighton are now second in the Premier League, five points behind Arsenal.
